blocks.text: The suffix "-ся" with some verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another (reciprocal action). Thus: встречаться (to meet), знакомиться (to become acquainted), здороваться (to greet each other) etc. The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "с": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "-ся" the verb встречать — встретить is used with the direct object in the Accusative case: *Вчера я встретил моего друга.* but: *Мы встретились на улице.*

We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups. Group 1. Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject: *Я моюсь. Мы готовимся к экзамену.* Group 2: *Наступление начинается. Урок продолжается 50 минут.* Group 3. Reciprocal verbs: *Мы часто встречаемся. Он хочет с вами познакомиться.* Group 4. Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся": *Я боюсь вашего брата. Он смеётся над вами.*
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 66–67.

The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.

exercises.q: One year later, Paul was born.
exercises.why: «The verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups»: reflexive (я моюсь), intransitive (урок продолжается), reciprocal (мы встречаемся), and verbs which never occur without "-ся". — DLI, Lesson 67. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
